summary.prompt: FantasyDisk elementalist playable hero, dark fantasy D&D elemental caster, bright multi-element unarmed mage with readable fire, ice, lightning and stone motifs integrated into robe trim, shoulder mantle and color accents only. Empty open hands, no staff, no wand, no orb, no prism, no crystal focus, no meteor, no floating elemental spheres, no held prop, no weapon, no UI frame, no text. Transparent background. Full body visible, centered sprite, strong clean human silhouette, visible arms and legs for walking animation, heroic but readable top-down RPG character, saturated elemental palette with crimson ember, icy cyan, storm gold and earth stone accents, not sci-fi, not cute, no baked spell effects around hands.
